title: Point-power strict insertion specialization
statement: Fix a finite-field datum D, with algebraic closure k, prime characteristic p and geometric Frobenius automorphism h, a prime l different from p, and a finite extension E of Q_l. Use the completed module category, the strict quotient-linear system category, the recursively defined powers pointPower D r, and the normalized strict insertion u_r of [lem-trf-point-system-transport-descent]. In the notation of [def-trf-point-power-roos-coherence-data], there exists a family P of completed-module compositors d_m, strict-system compositors t_m, scalar-restriction comparisons b_r and finite tensor compositors. The maps d_m, t_m and b_r are the identity on every underlying site section, expressed by HasSiteSections, HasSystemSections and HasRestrictionSections. The finite tensor compositor sends two consecutive inserted units to one inserted unit, expressed by HasTensorUnits with the recorded finite comparison j. For every m >= 1 and every strict system complex M the entire tower chain maps satisfy u_{m+1,M} = u_{m,M} followed by u_{1,G_m M} followed by Gamma(t_{m,M}), that is StrictTransportCoherence. No boundedness, constructibility or cartesianness assumption is imposed.

proof.text: Induct on r to identify pointPower D r with h^r using the successor equations. Apply [lem-trf-point-system-insertion-composition] with k=D.k and h the geometric Frobenius. For positive r use the index r-1; use identity-site unit comparisons at zero. Its SectionLaws give the completed and strict compositors and restriction comparison. The unique sectionwise specification of coefficient in [lem-trf-point-system-transport-descent] identifies the scalar maps after this reindexing.

Use the finite tensor-unit characterization of [lem-trf-point-system-insertion-composition]. Conjugate its tensor compositor by the specified inverseImageFiniteComparisonComplex isomorphisms. TensorLaws identifies multiplication of the two units, including transport along the given HEq between the reindexed section carriers. This proves HasTensorUnits for the original finite comparison maps.

The restriction component equation in StrictInsertionLaws identifies complexInsertion with the recorded chainTransport by [lem-trf-point-system-transport-descent], chainTransport_existsUnique. Compose with the inverse complex composition iso appearing in u. Transport the strict chain compositor equation through this identity to obtain StrictTransportCoherence, retaining every transition and differential.
